issues.detail: Hebrew 'הַנִּצָּבָה' (the standing/healthy ones) is rendered as '健壯的' (the strong/healthy), but the clause 'לֹ֣א יְכַלְכֵּ֔ל' (he will not feed/sustain) is omitted entirely. The Chinese skips the third negative action about not feeding the standing ones, instead jumping to the final clause about eating the fat and breaking their hoofs.
